title: Future Bite
summary: A futuristic restaurant management and ordering system with real-time operations.
description: A full-stack restaurant management and ordering platform built with Next.js and deployed to Cloudflare. Features menu management, ordering flow, and real-time updates, backed by Cloudflare D1 and R2.

title: KNYI Portfolio
summary: A personal portfolio site with a built-in content management system.
description: A Next.js portfolio website with a CMS for managing content, deployed to Cloudflare Workers with D1 storage.

title: Little Paradise
summary: A premium music streaming app with synchronized lyrics and mood-based discovery.
description: A full-stack music streaming web app with a Liquid Glass UI: persistent audio player, synchronized LRC lyrics, mood-based discovery, playlists, favorites, and user accounts. Deployed to Cloudflare Workers with D1, R2, and KV.

title: Myanmar Beer Survey & Rewards
summary: A customer survey and rewards platform with a lucky spin wheel.
description: A full-stack survey and rewards platform for Myanmar Beer. Users complete a product survey, spin a virtual wheel to win prizes, and submit delivery details. Includes an admin dashboard for managing surveys, products, rewards, and deliveries.

title: Osiris
summary: A requirements-first web engineering studio website.
description: A requirements-first web development business website showcasing an engineering philosophy where technology is selected after understanding the business problem. Features an interactive hero, project blueprint builder, process timeline, and case studies.

title: Velora Tarot
summary: A cinematic, mystical tarot reading experience with 3D card flips.
description: A mystical tarot reading web app with a dark, atmospheric interface. Users select a reading type, shuffle the deck, choose cards, and receive detailed interpretations through 3D card flips, particle backgrounds, and atmospheric glows.

title: The Guys (AUREVIA)
summary: A premium digital marketing agency experience with cinematic storytelling.
description: A premium digital marketing agency website turning the agency philosophy — Attention → Story → Amplify → Convert → Grow — into an editorial, cinematic, interactive narrative. Built with Next.js, GSAP, and Tailwind CSS, deployed to Cloudflare Workers.

title: Velocity
description: A premium, futuristic, cinematic multi-brand automotive showroom built with Next.js, React, and Tailwind CSS, backed by Cloudflare D1 and R2.
